publication: Local implementation not published; this scalar snapshot cannot independently replay code

summary.scope: Real Anymate subset: 96 train/16 validation/32 test; 83/14/32 eligible single-root skeletons; 2000 steps, three seeds per condition, width64/layers2, 256 train queries and 512 eval queries
summary.claim: Held-out reconstruction proxy; GT rig geometry remains a conditioning input. Rig-context mode also uses GT skin weights to form context. Not image-conditioned generation or original-paper numerical reproduction.
summary.selection: Each seed checkpoint selected by validation loss; all three seeds reported, no best test seed
summary.uncertainty: Mean and sample standard deviation across three training seeds, not confidence intervals over original benchmark

data_audit.official_split: train and val exclusively original train0; test exclusively original test

generation_preflight.scope: Original TRAIN asset preflight only; never train on test meshes; original files and images remain local
generation_preflight.render_scope: Original train asset, four 224x224 CPU Cycles views; explicit independent normalization; not author TRELLIS rendering or learned mesh reconstruction

dinov2.scope: Real original-train-asset views and pretrained features only; no Sparse VAE, FlexiCubes or generator training; not fed into completed geometry-feature runs

surface_feature_projection.visibility: Blender ray cast per original mesh vertex, tolerance 2e-4; four-view patch bilinear average
surface_feature_projection.scope: Actual sparse surface feature input only; no learned TRELLIS encoder/SLats

runs.scope: Held-out reconstruction proxy, not image-conditioned generation; skinning uses supplied GT bones and same-index weights only within that oracle-bone task
runs.legacy: evaluation.json retains v1 analytic J2B and equal-bone quadrature B2B; not used as paper-equivalent metrics
runs.skeleton_definition: Un-squared symmetric mean/2; RigNet bone sampling round(length/0.005), on the explicit unit geometry box
runs.skin_definition: Element mean L1 and vector-sum L1 both retained; L2 vector norm separate from mean squared element; threshold=.05

config.name: round1
config.task_scope: Local geometry-feature decoder training. GT bones at skinning evaluation; rig mode context also encodes GT skin weights. Not image-conditioned generation or full Sparse VAE.
config.checkpoint_selection: Minimum validation teacher-forced skeleton+skin CE; test not used for selection
